headline: Congress named a VA outpatient clinic in Auburn, California, the Louis A. Conter VA Clinic.
what_it_does: This law renames the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Auburn, California. The new name honors Louis A. Conter. It does not change the clinic's services, staffing, or hours.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
